AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: These functions allow chefs to discover and learn how to cook simple recipes. Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchRecipes' to search for recipes using various filters. - Use 'getRecipe' to get the details of a specific recipe by ID. - Use 'getDefinition' to look up the definition of cooking-related terms. Constraints: - The recipe ID must be a valid, positive integer.
